slides.texte_overlay:
underrated habits that make
you look so put together

a reset every evening

spend ten minutes each evening putting things back where they belong. waking up to a calm, tidy room makes you feel organised before the day even starts.

a calendar you trust

write every plan and deadline in one place and check it each morning. people who never forget things aren't smarter, they simply stopped trusting their memory.

arriving five minutes early

being a little early to everything makes you look calm and reliable. it also gives you time to breathe instead of rushing in flustered and apologising.

being well informed

knowing a little about art, history and science makes you sound composed in any conversation. 5 minutes a day is honestly enough to build it up over time.

slides.texte_overlay:
simple outfits

keep a few simple outfits that always work together. getting dressed quickly and well every morning saves energy and makes you look effortlessly put together.
